question: Should this Gateway public-network hardening bundle be accepted as default-on core behavior, narrowed behind opt-in configuration, or split into smaller reviewed PRs?
rationale: The PR changes public security boundaries, Gateway availability defaults, and sensitive audit logging behavior, which requires maintainer intent rather than an automated repair choice.

options.title: Require opt-in or split hardening first
options.body: Refresh the branch, split or gate risky defaults, complete schema/help/docs/tests, and require real Gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Accept default-on hardening deliberately
options.body: Maintainers may own the stricter defaults if upgrade impact, privacy posture, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof are documented first.

options.title: Close and request narrower proposals
options.body: If the bundle is too broad to review safely, preserve the discussion and ask for separate IP ACL, rate-limit, audit-log, HSTS, and bind-fallback PRs.

recommendation.title: Require opt-in or split hardening first
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch, split or gate risky defaults, complete schema/help/docs/tests, and require real Gateway proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the current Gateway net/config/security surfaces whose defaults and contracts this PR changes.
